plan.summary: Two read-only data-list endpoints + SPA consumption. (A) Projeler modal aha pack 1/2/3/4/5: unified GET /api/v1/data-lists/preview-sample?listIds= -> {sample: first sendable record of first selected list, reach: COUNT(DISTINCT phone) across selected lists (sendable), column_stats: per-column filled/total} feeding (#2) sample-recipient live preview toggle in the WhatsApp bubble, (#3) column dropdown options with sample value + fill %, (#4) precise unique-reach counter in the target-lists header; plus client-only (#1) placeholder->column auto-match on template pick and (#5) dirty-form close guard. (B) Veri Yönetimi Listeler tab: double-click (or eye icon) on a list row opens a records viewer popup -> new GET /api/v1/data-lists/{id}/records?search=&page=&pageSize= (server-paged, ILIKE search across text columns, static SQL).
plan.q_intent: Q: 'aha 1 2 4 5 yapmak için auto çalıştır' + '3ü de ekle' + 'veri içeri aktarma sayfasında listeye çift tıklayınca içeriğini tablo olarak görebileceğim ve search yapılabilecek güzel bir popup ekle' + 'diğer sessiondaki işi bitince başla' (SS-D landed first, base pulled).
plan.interview_notes: Q decisions: unified endpoint (one call feeds #2+#3+#4, reach is PRECISE/deduped) over client-only rough sum; sample source = first sendable record of FIRST selected list automatically (no extra picker UI). Viewer defaults (announced, no objection): empty columns hidden, search across all text columns, 50/page, dbl-click + eye icon trigger. Reuses ContactList error-code family (no new INV codes). Tenant scoping IS the ownership check for preview-sample (foreign ids contribute nothing); {id}/records 404s via existing GetAsync when the list isn't the tenant's.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /api/v1/data-lists/preview-sample?listIds=1,2 returns {sample (first sendable record of first list, null when none), reach (COUNT DISTINCT normalized_phone across selected lists, sendable only), column_stats (per-column filled/total over sendable rows)} — tenant-scoped, ContactList-gated, static SQL.

GET /api/v1/data-lists/{id}/records?search=&page=&pageSize= returns a server-paged records page (total + rows) with ILIKE search across phone/name/surname/email/field1-5/tags/note; LIKE wildcards in user input are escaped; pageSize clamped; 404 when the list is not this tenant's.

Projeler modal: (#1) picking a template auto-fills column dropdowns for placeholders whose key matches a column alias (ad/name, soyad/surname, email/eposta, etiket/tags, not/note, field1-5); (#2) the WhatsApp preview can toggle raw {{...}} vs the sample recipient's real values for mapped placeholders; (#3) each column option shows the sample value + fill %; (#4) the target-lists header shows the precise unique-recipient reach (debounced, fail-silent); (#5) closing a dirty form asks for confirmation.

Veri Yönetimi Listeler tab: double-click on a row (or the eye icon) opens an X-close popup with the list's records as a table (entirely-empty columns hidden), a debounced search box, and prev/next paging with 'X-Y / Z' counts.

verification_questions.question: Are both new endpoints strictly read-only, tenant-scoped on every query (tenant_id predicate on list_records/data_lists), and behind the existing ContactList gate — with foreign list ids unable to leak any other tenant's data?

Is the records search SQL static (single parameterized pattern, no string concatenation) with LIKE wildcard escaping of user input, and are page/pageSize clamped server-side so an arbitrary query cannot become unbounded?
Do the modal aha features fail SOFT — if preview-sample errors or returns nothing, the modal still works exactly as before (no blocked save, no crash; sample toggle and stats simply absent)?

Does the dirty-form guard only intercept closeModal (X) and not the successful-save path, and is the snapshot taken AFTER the async edit re-populate so an untouched edit form is not falsely flagged dirty?
